This Guide Covers ⚗️ tl;dr 

Images, screenshots and walk-through how-to guide & tutorial: 

Introduction to Claude Skills: Claude’s Skills feature allows users to create reusable instructions for specialized tasks, such as adhering to brand guidelines, saving time on repetitive workflows; these skills are compatible with ChatGPT and Gemini for broader use.

Usage Example: By enabling Anthropic’s brand guidelines skill, Claude generates presentations that align with specific company styles, like Anthropic’s, compared to generic outputs without skills.

Enabling and Applying Skills: Access Skills via Settings > Capabilities, toggle on pre-built ones, and invoke them either manually via “Try in chat” or automatically through prompts; always enable the skill-creator for best results.

Creating Custom Skills: Prompt Claude to build a skill (e.g., for Google branding), receive a downloadable ZIP file with Markdown instructions and resources, then upload it to Claude for use in new chats.

Cross-Platform Compatibility and Limitations: Export ZIP files to ChatGPT or Gemini for similar automation; however, Skills require a paid subscription, may yield inconsistent results, and can activate unintentionally if not managed.

How to Use Claude Skills to Automate Your Workflow

An amazing feature that even ChatGPT and Gemini users can benefit from

By The PyCoach, October, 2025. 

If you’ve ever struggled to get tasks done quickly (whether for yourself or your team) using custom GPTs or projects, you should try Claude Skills.

Claude’s new Skills feature lets you generate reusable instructions to help it perform specialized tasks like following your company’s standards more reliably

Skills are good for:

Teaching Claude how to deal with specific tasks

Saving hours on repetitive tasks

Creating custom workflows

The best part is that skills generated with Claude can also be used on ChatGPT and Gemini (more on that later).
